title: Relative Clauses, Emphasis and Time Reference (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj zdania (1.1.-1.8.). Wykorzystujac wyrazy podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij kazde zdanie z luka tak, aby precyzyjnie oddac sens zdania wyjsciowego. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna wpisywanych fragmentow zdan. Uwaga: nie zmieniaj formy podanych wyrazow. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac maksymalnie piec wyrazow, wliczajac w to wyraz juz podany. Formy skrocone (np. needn't, they're) sa liczone jako dwa wyrazy.

items.original: The hotel where we stayed last summer has closed down.
items.transformed: The hotel _________ last summer has closed down.

items.original: Nobody knows the reason for his sudden resignation.
items.transformed: Nobody knows _________ his job so suddenly.

items.original: As soon as I saw her face, I knew something was wrong.
items.transformed: The _________ her face, I knew something was wrong.

items.original: There is no point in complaining about the weather.
We only realised our mistake much later.
items.transformed: It _________ that we realised our mistake.

items.original: He left the company five years ago.
My brother is the person I trust most.
items.transformed: My brother is the person _________ most.

items.original: I did not enjoy the film; I enjoyed the book.
